description: Commission of Elections - Mr. H. W. Ranil Gunathilaka elected as member of Hakmana Pradeshiya Sabba
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Hakmana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under electoral processes and related administrative matters for local authorities.
